p.espaces.rg_d: Customs, product standards, business start-ups, investment platforms: official sources of each country.
p.espaces.rg_sub: Rules change often: ONE WORLD does not copy them, it opens the latest official sources, and then you read them in your language.
p.espaces.rg_g1: Global Trade Helpdesk (ITC, UNCTAD, WTO): for products and countries, debts, taxes, rules and procedures on one page
p.espaces.rg_g2: Market Access Map (ITC): customs duties and source rules
p.espaces.rg_g3: ePing (WTO): standards, labels and health rules this country sets for products
p.espaces.rg_e1: Access2Markets: trading with and from the EU, step by step
p.espaces.rg_e2: TARIC: code and customs duties on entry into the EU
p.espaces.rg_b1: Business Ready (World Bank): starting a business, taxes, international trade, country by country
p.espaces.rg_i1: I-SCAN (IOSCO): check that a platform has not been fanned by managers before trusting it with money
p.espaces.rg_note: A website opens in its own language: use your browser's translation, or "Understand document" for a document. If you have a serious decision, ask a professional in that country.
p.espaces.cu_d: Duties, documents, Incoterms, free official tools, carriers and suppliers.
p.espaces.cu_sub: The guide to buying and selling between countries. 24/24 ONE WORLD does not file customs declarations: a licensed customs trader (producer freight forwarder) can do that on your behalf.
p.espaces.cu_t1: Market Access Map (ITC, UN-WTO): obligations and rules for almost every country
p.espaces.cu_t2: Access2Markets (European Union): debts, taxes, source rules, step by step
p.espaces.cu_t3: TARIC: classification code (HS code) and duties on entry into the European Union
p.espaces.cu_d3: Transport document: Bill of lading (sea), Bill of lading (air), CMR (road)
p.espaces.cu_d4: Certificate from source (to have reduced responsibilities)
p.espaces.cu_d5: EORI number (EU importing or exporting companies)
p.espaces.cu_d6: Depending on the product: health or biological certificate, license, CE standards
p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: the buyer handles everything from the seller's factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: the seller delivers the goods cleared for export to the buyer's carrier.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: the seller loads the goods on the ship; after that, risks and costs are the buyer's.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: the seller pays for the shipment and insurance to the port of arrival.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: seller delivers to address, buyer pays import taxes.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: the seller pays everything, including import taxes.
p.espaces.cu_ban: Forbidden or controlled worldwide: weapons, drugs, counterfeits, protected species (CITES), some medicines. Such lists are rejected and can be reported (at).
p.espaces.cu_src: Source: ICC (Incoterms 2020), ITC, European Commission, douane.gouv.fr. Always check the correct rules for your product.
p.espaces.b_kind_mission: Remote job or gig (offering or looking)
p.espaces.mt_d: Western Union, MoneyGram, Wise, Remitly... compare the fees for your country before you send.
p.espaces.mt_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD does not send money itself and does not earn anything from these connections: compare here, then send with the service of your choice.
p.espaces.mt_wb: Global Money Transfer Prices (World Bank): the actual cost of sending money, country by country, service by service
p.espaces.mt_p_wu: Collect cash in many countries, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_mg: Collect cash, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_wise: Bank transfer at market rate, fees shown before you send
p.espaces.mt_p_rem: Bank transfer, mobile wallet, cash collection
p.espaces.mt_p_wr: Mobile wallet, bank transfer, cash collection
p.espaces.mt_p_tt: Send to mobile money walls or bank account
p.espaces.mt_k1: Look at the total received: fees + exchange rate. A rate worse than the market rate is a hidden cost.
p.espaces.mt_k2: Choose how the person receives it: cash, bank account or mobile wallet (M-Pesa, Orange Money, MTN...).
p.espaces.mt_k3: An ID document is often required, to send and to collect.
p.espaces.mt_k4: Never send money to someone you've met online, or to "unlock" a prize, package, loan or visa: it's almost always a crime.
p.espaces.mt_note: Change services and prices: check their website every time you send.
p.espaces.ds_d: selling out of stock: finding a supplier, working out the actual price, and staying within the law.
p.espaces.ds_sub: Dropshipping means selling a product that the supplier ships directly to your customer. Easy to start, but you are responsible for the sale.
p.espaces.ds_s1: Choose products that are allowed in your customers' country: no counterfeits, no unauthorized regulated products.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Find a supplier ("Wholesale / supplier" listings here or wholesale platforms) and order a sample before you sell.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Work out the real price: product, shipping, sales tax, VAT of the customer's country, payment fees and returns.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Tell your customers the actual delivery time.
p.espaces.ds_s5: Register your activities: business status, gross value added tax and payments according to your country (see trade rules).
p.espaces.ds_s6: Respecting consumer rights: clear prices including taxes, right of return, warranty, data protection.
p.espaces.ds_w1: A supplier who wishes to pay in full by unsecured bank transfer or in crypto-debit.
p.espaces.ds_w2: Paid courses that guarantee to make you rich quickly.
p.espaces.ds_w3: Uploaded photos and fake reviews: banned and punished.
p.espaces.ds_w4: In the European Union, a package from outside the EU pays gross value added tax (VAT) from the first euro.
p.espaces.ds_plat: Wholesale platforms (private, not connected to 24/24 ONE WORLD)
